name: Keysight IxFlow | Unmatched Traffic
description: Traffic IxFlow could not classify (application "unknown", classification "Unmatched traffic").

header.title: Unclassified Bytes
header.description: Bytes of flows IxFlow could not classify (application "unknown").

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Unclassified Bytes

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) unwind=true | limit 1000 | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb)

config.description: Bytes of flows IxFlow could not classify (application "unknown").

header.title: Server Ports
header.description: Distinct server ports of unclassified traffic.

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Server Ports
config.description: Distinct server ports of unclassified traffic.

header.title: Classification Values
header.description: Distinct values of IxFlow traffic classification (3054:288).

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Classification Values
config.description: Distinct values of IxFlow traffic classification (3054:288).

header.title: Unclassified Traffic Volume
header.description: Client and server bytes of unclassified flows over time.

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Unclassified Traffic Volume

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | timeAggr ixClientBytes=sum(clientBytes), ixServerBytes=sum(serverBytes) on timestamp interval="${AUTOBUCKET_INTERVAL}" dir="desc" unwind=true bucketAlias="srcEventTimestamp" | limit 500

config.description: Client and server bytes of unclassified flows over time.

header.title: Classified vs Unknown
header.description: Share of bytes per application - shows how much is "unknown".

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Classified vs Unknown

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | fork (sort ixBytes desc | limit 5), (sort ixBytes desc | limit 5, ALL | aggr ixBytes=sum(ixBytes), total=count(1) | set ixApplication="Others", _isOtherRow=true)

config.description: Share of bytes per application - shows how much is "unknown".

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by protocol as protocolName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 8

header.title: Unclassified Server Endpoints
header.description: Server IP / port / protocol receiving unclassified traffic.

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Unclassified Server Endpoints

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp), ixFirstSeen=min(firstTimestamp), ixLastSeen=max(timestamp) by serverIp as serverIp, serverPort as serverPort, protocol as protocolName, ixServerIpCountryName as ixServerIpCountryName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

config.description: Server IP / port / protocol receiving unclassified traffic.

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcServerIp=dc(serverIp), ixDcServerPort=dc(serverPort) by clientIp as clientIp, ixClientIpCountryName as ixClientIpCountryName, ixClientAsName as ixClientAsName unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500

header.title: Top Server Ports
header.description: Server ports with the most unclassified bytes.

config.name: IxFlow | UNM Top Server Ports

hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixApplication = "unknown" | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes) by serverPort as serverPort unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 15

config.description: Server ports with the most unclassified bytes.

queries.nql: ixApplication != null | aggr ixCb=sum(clientBytes), ixSb=sum(serverBytes), ixFlows=sum(flows), ixDcClientIp=dc(clientIp) by ixTrafficClassification as ixTrafficClassification, ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixBytes=add(ixCb,ixSb) | sort ixBytes desc | limit 500
